faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the J&K Anganwadi Helper post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Anganwadi Helper (Sahayika) post is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is matriculation. However, candidates with at least an 8th standard pass can also be considered if no matriculate candidates are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Anganwadi Helper post?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 to 37 years as on January 1, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Anganwadi Helper post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Anganwadi Helper (Sahayika) position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to send their application forms to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Anganwadi Helper post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed on an honorarium basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Anganwadi Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves document verification and selection based on marks obtained in the 10th class, with preference given to certain categories of women.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website: www.jkicds.com.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates need to be attached.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is CDPO/SOP/Estt/2026/538-48.
